title: Sales Executive (Ford)
fit: Experience not required: they hire people starting out. Allen say their average sales advisor earned £47,500 last year. 5 days, 42 hours.
desc: Handle face-to-face, phone, email and digital enquiries; meet personal and team sales targets; guide customers through purchase including warranty, accessories and finance; follow FCA rules on finance and insurance sales; passion for customer service; selling and influencing skills; full UK licence.
cover:
Hi,

I'd like to apply for the Sales Executive role at Allen Ford Northampton.

I'm starting my automotive sales career, but I'm not starting from zero. At BCA in Bedford I deal with dealership teams every day, moving vehicles, handling MOT and service movements and supporting handovers. Before that I sold premium promotional packages at Curve Media, handling inbound and outbound enquiries by phone and email and working to targets.

I'm confident on the phone, I follow up, and I enjoy matching people to the right product. I'd welcome the chance to learn the Ford range and your sales process.

Rougier Williams
07407 433797

profile: Customer-focused sales professional ready to start a career in car sales with a busy franchised dealership. At BCA in Bedford I work inside the dealership world every day: drop-offs and collections with dealer teams, MOT and service movements, vehicle preparation and customer handovers.

At Curve Media I sold premium promotional packages by phone, email and direct outreach, handling enquiries from first contact through to close and working to targets. I'm confident on the phone, persistent with follow-up and keen to learn the Ford range, finance and the complete sales process.
cv.objective: To join Allen Motor Group as a Sales Executive at Ford Northampton, combining my dealership experience and phone-based sales background, and to learn the Ford range, finance products and the full sales process.
changes: Profile leads with handling enquiries and targets, as the advert asks
Skills now match their wording: phone, email and digital enquiries
Curve Media bullets lead with lead generation and the full sales process

prep:
30-SECOND PITCH
I move cars for dealerships every day at BCA, so I know how a showroom runs, and before that I sold premium packages by phone and email at Curve Media. I haven't sold cars yet, but I can handle enquiries, follow up and close, and I want to learn it properly with Allen.

LIKELY QUESTIONS
• Why car sales? You've worked around cars at BCA and loved the handover moment; you've already sold, now you want to sell the product you know.
• How would you handle a phone enquiry? Ask what they drive now, what they need, budget, part-exchange, then book an appointment.
• Tell us about a sale you closed. Use a real Curve Media deal: how you found them, the objection, how you closed.
• Customer says they'll think about it? Find the real reason, deal with it, agree a next step and a date.

ASK THEM
• What do your best new starters do differently in the first 3 months?
• How are leads shared between the team?

RESEARCH
The current Ford range (Puma, Kuga, Ranger, Transit Custom), Allen's own Ford offers and reviews.
checkNote: Listing open and apply page loads

title: Car Sales Executive (Volkswagen)
fit: Highest basic on the list, with £3,333 guaranteed in your first month. They want previous sales experience in automotive OR another customer-facing role, so your Curve Media sales counts. 40 hrs, Mon–Sat, Sundays on rota.
desc: Guide customers from first enquiry to handover; understand needs and recommend new or used cars plus finance and insurance; target-driven; strong communication and rapport; previous sales experience (automotive or fast-paced customer-facing); 3-day sales training course.
cover:
Hi,

I'd like to apply for the Car Sales Executive role at Marshall Volkswagen Milton Keynes.

I work at BCA in Bedford, moving vehicles between dealerships, handling MOT and service movements and supporting customer handovers, so I know how a busy dealership runs. Before BCA I spent over a year in sales at Curve Media, generating my own leads by cold calling and email and closing premium packages with business owners.

I haven't sold cars yet, but I'm used to targets, rejection and building rapport quickly. I'm ready to learn the Volkswagen range and the finance process, and I'm happy to work the weekend rota.

Rougier Williams
07407 433797

profile: Target-driven sales professional with over a year of B2B sales at Curve Media and daily dealership experience at BCA, looking to build a career as a Car Sales Executive. I generated my own leads by cold calling and email, discovered client needs and closed premium packages with business owners.

At BCA I deliver and collect vehicles for dealerships, prepare cars to presentation standard and support customer handovers, so I understand the journey from enquiry to handover from the inside. I'm ready to learn the Volkswagen range, finance and insurance products, and Marshall's customer journey.
cv.objective: To join Marshall Volkswagen Milton Keynes as a Car Sales Executive, using my sales background and dealership experience to give customers a great buying journey, and to grow through Marshall's sales training.
changes: Profile now leads with your sales experience, which this advert asks for
Skills reworded to match their enquiry-to-handover customer journey
Curve Media bullets lead with taking prospects from first contact to conversion

prep:
30-SECOND PITCH
I sold premium packages at Curve Media, finding my own leads and closing them, and now I work at BCA moving cars for dealerships and helping with handovers. I want to bring both together in a showroom, and Marshall's training is exactly what I'm after.

LIKELY QUESTIONS
• Sell me this car/pen: ask questions first, then match features to what they said.
• Why Volkswagen? Strong brand, wide range from Polo to ID models, loyal customers.
• How do you handle a target you're behind on? More calls, follow up every open lead, ask the manager for help early.
• Weekends? Yes to Saturdays and the Sunday rota.

ASK THEM
• What does the first month look like with the guaranteed earnings?
• How soon can I take the 3-day sales course?

RESEARCH
The VW range (Polo, Golf, T-Roc, Tiguan, ID.3, ID.4), Marshall's reviews, and the MK showroom on Google Maps.
checkNote: Listing open and apply page loads

title: Retail Consultant (Sales Executive)
fit: Sales experience isn't necessary. They prefer someone from a commission-based job, which your Curve Media work was. The ad covers Kettering, Leicester and Derby, so say Kettering when you apply.
desc: Retail Consultant (sales executive) for Volkswagen; commission-based role with high OTE; sales experience not necessary but commission-based background preferred; customer service focus; full UK licence.
cover:
Hi,

I'd like to apply for the Retail Consultant role at Parkway Volkswagen Kettering.

I work at BCA in Bedford, delivering and collecting cars for dealerships, handling MOT and service movements and helping with customer handovers. Before that I worked in commission-based sales at Curve Media, generating my own leads by cold calling and email and closing premium packages with business owners.

I haven't sold cars yet, but I'm used to targets, handling objections and closing. I have a full licence and I'm keen to learn the Volkswagen range and the finance side properly.

Thanks,
Rougier Williams
07407 433797

profile: Commission-driven sales professional moving into car retail. At Curve Media I sold premium promotional packages on results, generating my own leads by cold calling and email and closing deals with business owners and sports and music representatives.

At BCA in Bedford I work with dealerships daily on drop-offs, MOT and service movements, vehicle preparation and customer handovers. I'm motivated by earning what I sell and keen to learn the Volkswagen range and finance products at Parkway Kettering.
cv.objective: To join Parkway Volkswagen Kettering as a Retail Consultant, bringing a commission-based sales mindset and dealership experience, and to grow into one of the site's top earners.
changes: Profile leads with commission-based sales, which they prefer
Skills put self-generated leads and closing first
Objective names Kettering, as the advert covers three sites

prep:
30-SECOND PITCH
I've worked in commission-based sales at Curve Media, so I'm used to earning what I sell, and at BCA I'm in dealerships every day. I'm ready to learn Volkswagen and earn properly.

LIKELY QUESTIONS
• Why commission? It rewards effort, and you've already worked that way.
• How do you find customers when the showroom is quiet? Follow up old enquiries, service customers and your own network.
• Tell us about a hard sale. Use a real Curve Media example.

ASK THEM
• What do top earners here do every week?

RESEARCH
Parkway's Kettering site, the VW range, and their Google reviews.

title: Sales Advisor (Nissan) — send your CV

desc: Nissan Sales Advisor. Previous retail and sales experience with a sales track record; automotive experience not essential (full training). Driving licence essential. Saturdays and alternate Sundays on a 5–6 day rota.
cover:
Hi Glyn Hopkin Careers team,

I'd like to apply for a Sales Advisor role at your Milton Keynes site. My CV is attached.

I currently work at BCA in Bedford, handling dealership drop-offs and collections, MOT and service movements, and customer handovers, working every day with premium cars from Mercedes-AMG and Porsche to McLaren and Bentley.

Before BCA I worked in sales at Curve Media, generating my own leads through cold calling and email outreach and closing premium packages with business owners and football and music representatives.

I'm happy to work Saturdays and alternate Sundays, I have a full driving licence, and I'm ready to learn the full sales and finance process.

Kind regards,
Rougier Williams
07407 433797

profile: Sales professional with a proven track record at Curve Media, selling premium promotional packages to business owners and sports and music representatives through cold calling, email and direct outreach.

Now working at BCA in Bedford with dealerships every day on vehicle drop-offs, MOT and service movements and customer handovers. Keen to join Glyn Hopkin as a Nissan Sales Advisor, happy to work weekends, and ready to learn the full sales and finance process.
cv.objective: To join Glyn Hopkin Group as a Nissan Sales Advisor in Milton Keynes, using my sales track record and dealership experience, and to build a long-term career with an employee-owned business.
changes: Profile opens with your sales track record, which they ask for
Weekend availability added to skills, as it's essential for them

prep:
30-SECOND PITCH
I've got a sales track record from Curve Media and I work with dealerships every day at BCA. I'm happy with Saturdays and alternate Sundays and ready to learn Nissan.

LIKELY QUESTIONS
• Your best sale? Use a real Curve Media deal.
• Why Glyn Hopkin? Employee-owned, big group, room to progress.
• Weekend work? Yes.

ASK THEM
• How does the employee-ownership bonus work?

RESEARCH
The Nissan range (Qashqai, Juke, Ariya) and the MK site.

title: Trainee sales role — direct approach

cover:

Rougier Williams
07407 433797

At Curve Media I sold premium promotional packages to high-profile clients, including football and music representatives and business owners. I understand premium customers and want to learn the Land Rover range and sales process.

Defender, Discovery, Range Rover, Range Rover Sport and Velar.
